description: This file defines the IVersionManager interface in the Orleans framework, providing methods for managing grain interface version negotiation strategies, including setting compatibility and selector strategies for general and specific interfaces.

classes.name: IVersionManager
classes.description: Interface for managing grain interface version negotiation strategies in Orleans.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the global compatibility strategy for grain interface versions.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the global selector strategy for grain interface versions.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for a specific grain interface type.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the selector strategy for a specific grain interface type.
